subject: Data Engineering
title: Schema Registries
description: Learn Schema Registries in one minute.

hook.text: A producer changes a field from integer to string. Every consumer breaks. Nobody was warned.

buildup.text: A schema registry stores and versions schemas, enforcing compatibility rules for every change.

discovery.text: Before a schema change is deployed, the registry checks if it's backward or forward compatible.

twist.text: Incompatible changes are rejected automatically, preventing silent breakage across the pipeline.

climax.text: Schema registries turn schema management from a handshake agreement into an automated guardrail.

punchline.text: Register the schema. Reject the breaking change.

quiz.question: What does a schema registry enforce?
